xymon_cmd.description: Path and command name for the `xymon` binary.

xymon_srv.description: Where to find the Xymon server: IP:PORT or HOSTNAME:PORT.

query_type.description: The default query to execute. One of: clientlog, xymondboard, hostinfo, xymondlog, ghostlist, config, ping, version.

test_name.description: The test to use for selecting hosts or printing with xymondlog.

fields.description: The fields to print for xymondboard. Empty string uses xymon defaults.

sections.description: Section(s) to print for clientlog. Multiple sections are comma separated in the final config.
